newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-KUWAIT PLAYER BANNED ONE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KUWAIT PLAYER BANNED ONE YEAR.

text.p: Kuwait's Hussein Ali was suspended for one year and fined 5,000 Swiss francs ($3,860) by FIFA on Tuesday for verbally abusing and spitting at a referee.
The ban, which covers all domestic and international soccer, resulted from an incident during a Gulf Cup match against the United Arab Emirates on October 22.
FIFA also fined the national associations of Zimbabwe and Tanzania 15,000 Swiss francs ($11,500) each for playing in an unsanctioned tournament.
The two African countries, along with Zambia, Namibia and Mozambique were to meet in the Castle Cup, a competition that had not received FIFA approval.
Despite warnings from the world governing body, Tanzania and Zimbabwe went ahead with the first scheduled match.
The two associations maintained that the match was a friendly but FIFA determined that it was part of the planned tournament.
